title: events.track@v1 response
description: Canonical response for events.track@v1. Integrations may use a minimal response transformer that returns only `status` (and optionally `vendor_ref`); every other field is optional. Callers must ignore unknown fields.

status.description: `ok` when every record was accepted, `partial` when some were rejected.

accepted.description: Number of records the upstream accepted.

rejected.description: Records the upstream rejected, with an opaque reason each.

vendor_ref.description: Opaque upstream reference for support correlation. Never parse it; it does not identify the vendor.

raw.description: Optional opaque upstream body, included only by `full` response transformers for debugging. Its shape is NOT part of the contract and may change on any Hub-side cutover; never depend on it.
